failure_modes.description: Router misclassification on scheduling queries mid-flow
failure_modes.root_cause: Keyword collision: generic verbs ('works', 'knows') trigger knowledge classifier during scheduling
failure_modes.evidence: Found 40 cases where scheduling intent was not recognized
failure_modes.fix: Strengthen STRONG_KNOWLEDGE_RE to require question mark or explicit wh- word in scheduling context

failure_modes.description: Retrieval threshold (0.35) filters out relevant chunks or allows low-quality answers
failure_modes.root_cause: Threshold is hardcoded; different domains/query types may need different sensitivity
failure_modes.evidence: Found 44 cases of threshold-related retrieval failures
failure_modes.fix: Implement adaptive threshold based on query domain (education=0.4, projects=0.3, personal=0.35)

failure_modes.description: Latency spikes on certain query patterns
failure_modes.root_cause: LLM fallback in router / expensive embedding + reranking on long documents
failure_modes.fix: Implement LLM caching for router decisions; consider lightweight embeddings for projects domain
